summary: End-to-end tested the new Resource Directory feature. Backend: 11/11 pytest passing — GET /api/resources returns 48 seeded items with correct category counts (housing 10, food 12, clothing 9, social-services 9, mental-health 8); category filter works; unknown category returns []; POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/resources full CRUD verified (create → GET, update → GET, toggle inactive hides from public list, delete → gone); 400 error on missing name and missing category. Frontend: Header desktop Resource Directory dropdown works (trigger + hover menu + all 5 links, no header overflow at 1440px, About dropdown still functional alongside — multi-dropdown pattern OK); mobile menu shows 'RESOURCE DIRECTORY' section with 5 category links; public /resources/food renders resource-directory-page with h1='Food', all 5 quick-switch pills, active amber style on food tab, 12 cards each with tel: link + Google Maps link; other 4 categories render correct card counts (housing 10, clothing 9, social-services 9, mental-health 8); /resources/bogus renders resource-directory-invalid. Admin: zwatson login works; admin-tab-resources visible; admin-resources-panel with filter dropdown (showing counts per category) + '+ Add Resource' button; full CRUD flow — create modal opens with all 10 fields, save creates row, edit renames row (verified via API), toggle sets is_active=0 with 'Hidden' badge, delete removes row. Filter=food shows 12 rows, filter=housing shows 10 rows. Seed intact (48) after cleanup.

minor.issue: Preview stub endpoints do NOT require authentication (any client can POST/PUT/DELETE). Production Cloudflare Worker enforces JWT. Non-blocking for preview but flag for parity.

action_items: MINOR: Review request spec listed 8 mental-health resources but seed has 8 already — consistent. Spec listed 8 social-services but seed has 9. Not a bug — actual is >= 8; verify intended count with product owner.

MINOR: data-testid naming inconsistency vs review request. Spec called them 'resource-field-sort_order' and 'resource-field-is_active'; actual DOM uses 'resource-field-sort-order' and 'resource-field-active'. Fields work; naming is stylistic. Consider aligning to underscore or documenting the hyphen convention.
OPTIONAL: Preview /api/admin/resources CRUD endpoints have no auth (production D1 Worker does). Consider adding a token check for parity even in preview.
critical_code_review_comments: resources_seed.py is clean — 48 real Richmond+Henrico orgs across 5 categories, uses stable uuid5 for deterministic ids.
ResourceDirectory.jsx: safe URL/phone/address handling (normalizeUrl, telHref, mapsHref) — good defensive coding; empty/loading/error states all have data-testid; PageMeta included for SEO.
Header.jsx: activeDropdown state with hover timer works correctly for multiple dropdowns; text-[13px] keeps nav slim; whitespace-nowrap prevents wrapping. Overall clean refactor.

server.py Resource Directory stubs (lines 192–260) accept `dict` payloads with no Pydantic model — consider a schema for parity + validation depth. Category is not validated against the 5 allowed values (any string accepted).

AdminDashboard.jsx: handleSaveResource + list mutation is done optimistically without refetch — minor risk of drift vs backend (e.g., server-side sort_order coercion). Not observed in testing but worth noting.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_resources.py (new — 11 pytest cases covering public + admin CRUD)
